'''Lvl-6 Enchant''' is a [[utility spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 87 [[Magic]] to cast. The spell enchants [[onyx]] [[jewellery]], granting 97 Magic experience when doing so.

This spell can be transferred to a [[Enchant onyx|magic tablet]] by bringing the required runes and a piece of [[soft clay]] to a [[lectern]] in the [[study]] of a [[player-owned house]], granting 72.8 [[Magic]] experience per tablet.
